events.info: From the creators of the smash hits The Simon & Garfunkel Story and R.E.S.P.E.C.T. The Aretha Franklin Story comes an electrifying new docu-concert: The Phil Collins Story. It's a high-energy, hit-packed party that takes you on a nostalgic ride from Phil's chart-topping days with Genesis to the unforgettable solo anthems you know by heart, and even the Oscar-winning magic of his Disney hits. Sing along, clap along, and feel every beat as this concert experience brings Phil Collins' legendary music to life with stunning visuals, dynamic projections, and powerhouse musical talent. It's a journey through decades of iconic songs, unforgettable moments, and pure feel-good energy. From the first note to the final encore, the hits keep coming, and the party never stops.
